task.title: Create and configure a notifications group
task.shortdesc: An Organization Administrator of a Hybrid Cloud Console account creates a group with the Notifications administrator role and adds members to the group.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as an Organization Administrator. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .

step.cmd: Under Identity & Access Management, click User Access.
In the left navigation panel, expand User Access if necessary and then click Groups.
Enter a group name, for example, Notifications administrators, and a description, and then click Next.
Select the role to add to this group, in this case Notifications administrator, and then click Next.

substep.cmd: Search for individual users or filter by username, email, or status.
Check the box next to each intended member’s name, and then click Next.

step.cmd: On the Review details screen, click Submit to finish creating the group.
